name: dialectic_walker
summary: The closure pass. Walks the crystal chain backward from the present (latest record) to the oldest. For every step computes: IS (the thesis — the present record at this step), IS-NOT (the antithesis — antipodal wave + flipped time + negated sentence + zero-overlap n-grams), BECOMING (the synthesis — measured transition n → n+1 using the same gradient math as transition_field). Emits ~/.cc/dialectic_chain.jsonl as a parallel chain anchored to the present. Closes the architecture: every record now carries IS / IS-NOT / BECOMING crystals.
engine_pattern: deterministic reverse traversal of inference_master_chain. Cross-substrate antithesis composition (energy_inversion.invert_vec on wave; forward-flip on time; word-flip dict on sentence; n-gram zero-overlap count on vector). Becoming uses transition_field-style measurement on chain pairs.

the_dialectic.IS: the present record at step n — vector_emb, wave_emb, time_vec, sentence_emb (when present), forward_chain, crystal
the_dialectic.IS_NOT: antithesis across measurable axes — derived deterministically, no LLM call. is_not_wave = -wave_emb. is_not_time_forward = -time_forward. is_not_sentence_preview = word-flip dict applied. is_not_vector_overlap_count = how many other records share ZERO n-grams (loneliness measure).
the_dialectic.BECOMING: measured transition n → n+1 — delta_seconds (from ISO timestamps), value_delta_magnitude (across wave_emb), velocity, color_velocity, flow_sig_head (8-d DCT of magnitudes). Anchored at the present which has no 'becoming' because it IS the becoming.

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.oldest_step: fa55950e1d572aff  ("build spatial pipeline" — first real record)
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.is_not_unique_per_step: vector_overlap_count varies 0-17 across the 19 steps — measures each record's content rarity

output_chain_schema.step_attributes: step_index, chain_index, present_crystal, is_not_crystal, becoming_crystal, crystal, prev_step_crystal, next_step_crystal, becoming_velocity, is_not_overlap_count
output_chain_schema.step_data: tier, model, ts, prompt_preview, is_not_sentence_preview, is_not_wave_head, is_not_time_head, becoming_flow_sig_head, becoming_value_delta_mag, becoming_delta_seconds

substrate: ~/.cc/dialectic_chain.jsonl (ParserCursor-compatible — joinable with all other JSONL chains)

inbound_callers: CLI: python3 dialectic_walker.py walk | summary | step N
(planned) chat.py — every new chat turn appends a dialectic step

the_closure: Before this: chain only stored what HAPPENED. After: chain stores what HAPPENED + what DIDN'T HAPPEN (is-not) + what was BECOMING (synthesis). The present anchors the entire past as a measured trajectory. Reading dialectic_chain.jsonl forward (oldest → newest) tells the story of how the present came into being through repeated triad: thesis (is) → antithesis (is-not) → synthesis (becoming).
guarantees: Deterministic — same crystal chain → same dialectic_chain bytes
Anchored to present — step 0 is the latest record; the walk is past-pointing
Cross-substrate joinable — every IS-NOT and BECOMING crystal can be retrieved across the existing 22+ MoE lenses
Append-friendly — when a new chat turn lands, re-running walk produces a NEW step 0 and shifts the prior step 0 to step 1 (it now has a measurable becoming toward the new present)
usage_example:
from dialectic_walker import DialecticWalker
steps = DialecticWalker().walk()
print(steps[0].present_crystal, steps[1].becoming_velocity)
# Or via CLI:
# python3 core/lib/dialectic_walker.py summary
